description.value: Denny's on Davie Street is a 24/7 Canadian chain diner located in Vancouver's West End, just north of Sunset Beach. It serves all-day breakfast, lunch, and dinner with classic comfort food including pancakes, bennies, omelettes, and burgers. Cyclists finishing the Seawall or heading to or from the Grouse Grind will find a reliable, round-the-clock meal stop here.
